sentences.text: Jennifer Shrader Lawrence -LRB- born August 15 , 1990 -RRB- is an American actress .
Since 2015 , Lawrence has been the highest-paid actress in the world , and her films have grossed over $ 5.5 billion worldwide .
She appeared in Time 100 most influential people in the world in 2013 and Forbes Celebrity 100 the following year and in 2016 .	Time	Time (magazine)	100 most influential people in the world	Time 100
During her childhood , Lawrence performed in church plays and school musicals .
When she was 14 , a talent scout spotted her in New York .
She then moved to Los Angeles and began her acting career by playing guest roles in television shows .
Her first major role came as a main cast member on the sitcom The Bill Engvall Show -LRB- 2007 -- 2009 -RRB- .	The Bill Engvall Show	The Bill Engvall Show

Lawrence made her film debut with a supporting role in Garden Party -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , and had her breakthrough playing a poverty-stricken teenager in the independent drama Winter 's Bone -LRB- 2010 -RRB- .	Garden Party	Garden Party (film)

She achieved wider recognition for playing the mutant Mystique in X-Men : First Class -LRB- 2011 -RRB- , a role she reprised in later installments of the series .	Mystique	Mystique (comics)	the series	X-Men (film series)

Lawrence 's fame continued to grow with her starring role as Katniss Everdeen in the Hunger Games film series -LRB- 2012 -- 2015 -RRB- , which established her as the highest-grossing action heroine of all time .	Katniss Everdeen	Katniss Everdeen

She went on to earn various accolades from her collaborations with director David O. Russell .	various accolades	List of awards and nominations received by Jennifer Lawrence	David O. Russell	David O. Russell

Her performance as a depressed widow in the romance film Silver Linings Playbook -LRB- 2012 -RRB- received an Academy Award for Best Actress , making her the second youngest Best Actress Oscar winner .	Silver Linings Playbook	Silver Linings Playbook	Academy Award for Best Actress	Academy Award for Best Actress	second youngest Best Actress Oscar winner	List of oldest and youngest Academy Award winners and nominees#Best Actress in a Leading Role

Lawrence subsequently won a BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role for playing a troubled wife in the black comedy American Hustle -LRB- 2013 -RRB- .	BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role	BAFTA Award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role	American Hustle	American Hustle
She also received Golden Globe Awards for her roles in both of these films and for playing the eponymous inventor in the biopic Joy -LRB- 2015 -RRB- .	inventor	Joy Mangano	Joy	Joy (film)

Lawrence is known in the media for being a vocal advocate of feminism and gender equality , and is the founder of the Jennifer Lawrence Foundation through which she supports various charitable organizations .	feminism	feminism
